messages:
jordan_sales: Heads up — RidgeBank wants a sealed, offline POC. They need clear answers on packaging, upgrade cadence, hotfix SLA, and how billing/POC licensing works. Can we gather details?

maria_solutions: Copy. @vikram_engineer can you outline the bundle options and install flow for an air-gapped handoff? Also they insist on no outbound telemetry during the POC.

vikram_engineer: Two bundles we ship for sealed installs: 
- slim-runtime (850MB) — runtime + minimal deps, expects customer model repo or local cache
- full-operator (3.2GB) — operator, controller, runtime, onboarded models
For air-gapped deliveries we produce a signed tarball + CycloneDX SBOM and a sha256 manifest. Telemetry is offable via env `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=0`. We also include an offline verification script.

andrew_ops: Install pattern for fully offline: provide OCI tar (or USB), copy to jumpbox, run `install-offline.sh --token /tmp/activation.jwt`. Requirements: jumpbox with internet-ejected NIC, ACLs allowing only SCP from staging, `/opt/redwood` >= 50GB, and a maintenance window for operator upgrades.

carol_cust: They want no cloud callbacks at all during the 30d POC and a committed monthly patch window. Also asked how long a critical hotfix takes to apply.

vikram_engineer: Hotfix timelines: runtime-only patch: ~15–30 min including validation and restart. Operator/controller changes: ~45–60 min plus operator reconciliation. For sealed sites we prefer roll-forward; rollback needs pre-made snapshots (we'll require approval and snapshot upload before any operator upgrade).

maria_solutions: For cadence, recommended default for POCs: quarterly bundled updates + immediate security hotfixes as needed. If customer needs more frequent security deltas (monthly), we can do that but with a packaging & operational surcharge.

carol_cust: Billing model question from RidgeBank: is the POC usage-billed, subscription, or a flat seat/license?

jordan_sales: For sales-assisted POCs we usually do: 30d complimentary credits, then either a time-boxed flat POC license (one-off) or convert to reserved capacity (monthly commit) if they want throughput SLAs. Air-gapped installs carry a one-time packaging/signing fee and optional offline support seat.

maria_solutions: Confirming packaging fee covers SBOM generation, notarization, signature keys, and QA signing. Support seat is an add-on for 24/7 expedited patching and a guaranteed SLA. I'll add numbers to the SOW draft.

samantha_security: From their security questionnaire: they need KMS/HSM key wrapping, support for customer-provided signing keys, offline cert rotation process, CycloneDX SBOM, and proof of integrity. Also asked whether we support FIPS mode.

vikram_engineer: We support HSM/KMS integrations in Private deployments and can accept customer signing keys for the POC, or pre-sign artifacts with our signing key before handoff. FIPS mode is available but requires a FIPS-enabled bundle build (adds ~120MB). Note: enabling FIPS affects some crypto libraries and may change runtime performance slightly.

carol_cust: RidgeBank is asking if we can commit to a 48h security hotfix SLA during the POC. Can we?

maria_solutions: We can offer best-effort 48h for critical vulnerabilities if customer purchases the expedited support seat. Otherwise POC default is best-effort with a 7-day target for high-severity. We can put the 48h clause in the SOW contingent on the support add-on.

andrew_ops: Ops caveats to include in the SOW: required jumpbox network ACLs, maintenance access for first upgrade (SRE chaperone recommended), snapshot policy for rollback, disk/CPU minimums, and accepted change window times.

carol_cust: Legal asked what artifacts they must sign/approve before we hand off.

maria_solutions: We provide: signed bundle tarball, CycloneDX SBOM, SHA256 manifest, runbook, and a notarized cover letter for legal. I'll attach a sample manifest to the SOW.

vikram_engineer: Sample manifest line: `{\"bundle\":\"redwood-sealed-2026-04.tar.gz\",\"sha256\":\"e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924\",\"signed_by\":\"redwood-signer-v1\",\"sbom\":\"redwood-2026-04.cdx.json\"}`

deploy_bot: Reminder — Handoff review with RidgeBank scheduled 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC. :calendar:

jordan_sales: Action items: @maria_solutions draft SOW with packaging fee + support seat options and conditional 48h SLA, @vikram_engineer produce slim + FIPS bundle examples and emergency rollback playbook, @samantha_security prepare a one-page security appendix answering KMS/HSM/cert rotation and FIPS impacts. Carol, will send SOW to you EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

carol_cust: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick alignment.

maria_solutions: I'll drop a short checklist doc in the thread with maintenance window options and ping ops for availability.

vikram_engineer: Also adding exact upgrade commands and a minimal test checklist to verify offline install.

samantha_security: Will attach the security appendix and note any limitations.

jordan_sales: Closing — DM me for urgent items.
